cover_letter_text:
Hi,

I'm Marc, and I'd like to start out as a laboratory technician. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. You're taking on trainees with structured training, so I wanted to apply for the Laboratory Technician in Training role.

My course used AS 1726 and AS 1289, and I designed earthworks and pavements. Before that, on two projects in the Philippines, I helped with site inspections and quality checks and prepared the site reports and material records. I hold a White Card and a full Victorian driver's licence.

I can move to Western Australia and start three weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
